components.description: A dominated Bayesian experiment
components.notes: Definition supplies parameter/observation spaces, jointly measurable normalized likelihood, m, G, joint law Q and the fixed-vs-random parameter distinction. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Normalization and a complete posterior kernel
components.notes: Annex proves Q is a probability, m integrates to one with mu(G)=1, kernel measurability, full disintegration via pi-lambda, absolute continuity and integral formulas for nonnegative and signed h. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Comparing an event with its complement
components.notes: Definition supplies conditional-prior averaged likelihoods and B_H. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The update multiplier and its endpoint cases
components.notes: Annex proves posterior formula, odds identity, increase iff B_H>1, zero-likelihood endpoint branches and prior-null preservation (Kass-Raftery Sec.3.1 odds form). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A flag, a second measurement and a duplicated report
components.notes: Annex verifies 11/122, 363/400, copied-report posterior, 99p/(1+98p) monotone with endpoints 1/102 and 1/2. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Conditional sampling densities
components.notes: Definition supplies history-dependent conditional densities, L_n, m_n and regular paths. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Batch updating equals successive conditioning
components.notes: Annex proves prefix marginals, r_i=m_i/m_{i-1}, batch=successive updating, telescoping, a.s. regularity, exchangeability case and failure of unconditional marginals. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A specified future observation law
components.notes: Definition supplies future kernel R and predictive law. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Prediction, conditional means and total variance
components.notes: Annex proves kernel property, conditional-law identity, total variance decomposition and predictive covariance. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Bernoulli learning and several future draws
components.notes: Annex proves beta posterior, marginal, count factor, n=0, beta-binomial predictive, mean and variance by total variance, and worked numbers (3/4, 3/208, mode 4/5, 15/26 vs 9/16). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Normal learning with known observation variance
components.notes: Annex proves likelihood factorization, square identity, marginal density with constants, posterior, predictive laws and covariance v, and numerical case. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Transforming an inferred quantity and changing its prior
components.notes: Annex proves pushforward posterior, invariance under transported prior/likelihood/future kernel, and the theta vs theta^2 uniform-prior moments 2/3,3/4,1/2,3/5. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Exact sensitivity by reweighting and contamination
components.notes: Annex proves reweighted marginal and posterior, sharp odds bounds with attaining weights, contamination mixture formula, and the counterexample showing small eps need not stay small. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Posterior content and coverage
components.notes: Definition supplies measurable set procedures, posterior content and frequentist coverage. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Prior-average calibration and failure of uniform coverage
components.notes: Annex proves the prior-average identity, the Bernoulli interval endpoints and zero coverage at 0.99, and the normal credible interval content. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Loss and posterior risk
components.notes: Definition supplies finite action set, bounded loss, posterior risk, measurable tie-breaking. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Optimal actions and expected value of the observation
components.notes: Annex proves measurability of Bayes rule, integrated-risk optimality, value-of-observation inequality, two-action threshold with worked numbers, and posterior-mean uniqueness for squared error. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A finite predictive probability is optimal for its logarithmic score
components.notes: Annex proves Gibbs inequality with equality case incl. zero-mass reports, and cumulative score -log m_n. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: When an observation mechanism cancels, and when it does not
components.notes: Annex proves cancellation of parameter-free factors, counterexample with parameter-dependent recording, stopping-rule likelihood structure, first-success posterior and its equalities, and the selected-only vs predesignated experiments. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: From assumptions to a posterior report
components.notes: Method entry supplies the full procedure steps; its prerequisite results are the proved theorems above. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
